title: Switch to {{target}}
subtitle: Replace {{from}} with {{to}}. Only one SQL server is allowed on this host.
success: SQL engine switched and data migrated
bannerHint: If the other engine is already installed, you must confirm an exclusive switch (uninstall the other and migrate databases). Both cannot be installed together.
calloutBody: {{from}} packages are removed only after a successful export. If later steps fail, logical backups remain under the panel data directory.
noUserDbs: No user databases detected (system schemas only). The server engine will still be replaced.
ackLabel: I understand the engines are exclusive. Uninstall {{from}} and migrate data to {{to}}.
phraseMismatch: Phrase does not match. Type SWITCH exactly.

warn.exclusive: MySQL and MariaDB cannot run together as servers on one host (exclusive).
warn.uninstall_packages: Current SQL server packages will be removed from the system.
warn.logical_dump: User databases are logical-exported then imported. System schemas are not copied as files.
warn.dialect_risk: MariaDB- or MySQL-specific SQL may fail on import.
warn.no_replication: Replication settings, plugins, and binary logs are not migrated.
warn.root_auth: Root socket or password authentication may need reconfiguration after the switch.
warn.no_user_dbs: No user databases detected — only engine packages will change.
warn.has_user_dbs: {{count}} user database(s) will be exported and imported.

note.needsSwitch: This host already runs {{other}}. MySQL and MariaDB are exclusive — confirm switch (export → uninstall other → install → import).
note.badConfirmPhrase: Confirm phrase must be exactly SWITCH.
note.needAck: You must acknowledge exclusive switch (MySQL or MariaDB, not both).
note.switchNotNeeded: Switch not needed — use normal install.
note.migrateDataRequired: Data migration must be enabled when user databases exist.
note.datadirBackupFailed: Datadir backup failed — aborted before uninstall. Try starting the source service manually.
note.waitFailed: Target service did not become ready. Backup: {{dumpPath}}. Old datadir: {{datadir}}. Manual recovery required.
note.incomplete: Switch incomplete. Export retained at {{dumpPath}}. Old datadir at {{datadir}}. Do not purge again blindly.
note.datadirBackup: Old datadir backup: {{path}} (remove when satisfied: rm -rf {{path}})
note.frozenDetected: MySQL/MariaDB is FROZEN (not an apt failure). Path {{path}} (mode: {{mode}}). The package may be installed but the daemon refuses to start after an engine switch or downgrade. Clear freeze and re-init empty datadir if safe. Snippet: {{snippet}}
note.frozenClearFailed: Could not remove freeze marker {{path}} — remove manually as root.
note.datadirNotEmptySkipInit: Data directory already has system tables — skipped re-initialize.
note.nginxPortConflict: Nginx unit not active — Apache may still bind public :80; rebind Apache to 127.0.0.1:8080, then restart Nginx.
note.frozenShort: FROZEN ({{mode}}) — daemon blocked; unfreeze and repair required.
note.unfreezeNeedsConfirm: Confirm required to unfreeze (frozen={{frozen}}, emptyDatadir={{empty}}). POST with confirm:true.
note.unfreezeOk: Service {{unit}} is active after unfreeze repair.
note.unfreezePrompt: Click “Unfreeze and repair” to clear FROZEN and re-init empty datadir.
